visualReview.scope: Static detailed exterior preview; maximum fidelity remains pending.
visualReview.notes: Inspected every listed standard frame: four facades, shallow recesses, dark false windows, engaged corner piers, cornice dentils, low roof, elevated north door and surviving lower steps remain closed and legible. The corrected north false window clears the lintel. No further visible geometry defect in these views. Simplified repair scar and regular block treatment remain below the maximum-fidelity target.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all four shared-material angles, four near/far details and north-up placement fixture. Limestone and dark stone surfaces bind correctly and maintain repeat scale across the measured facade; recess relief remains visible. The generic regular stone coursing and roof material are a reusable surface treatment, not a reproduction of the original blocks. The flat-terrain fixture shows a centered, rotated structure with the north access side facing NNW.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-QID OSM outline supplies center and axis; the measured square body retains its native dimensions. Flat-terrain transform was viewed, but the excavated perimeter lies below surrounding modern ground and requires a real DEM/site comparison before geographic approval.

fidelityReview.notes: Maximum fidelity remains pending: irregular original masonry, fractures, cramp holes, engraved inscriptions, displaced north roof slab, eroded lower stair and excavated site perimeter are not reproduced. No maximum-fidelity approval is implied by the exterior render review.
